rule: Every figure here is a published list price or statistic, read from its primary page on the date given (the break-it figures were read on 2026-10-25 and are carried with their own date). The cost case multiplies them by the buyer's own numbers. None of it is a price for the BES layer, which is MIT-licensed with no licence fee.
